benefits: Activate Founders package: $1,000 in AWS credits for self-funded / bootstrapped startups

eligibility: Company founded within the last 10 years

formFields.label: Company website URL
formFields.hint: Use a live domain that matches your email domain — mismatches are a top rejection reason.

formFields.label: Work email address
formFields.hint: Use a company-domain email, not Gmail/Outlook.

formFields.label: Company founded date / year
formFields.hint: Must be within the last 10 years to qualify.

formFields.label: Funding stage
formFields.hint: Founders package = self-funded; Portfolio = pre-Series B and provider-backed.

formFields.label: AWS account ID (the account that receives the credits)
formFields.hint: Reviewers cross-check that the account is new to Activate credits; use the account you actually intend to build on.

formFields.label: Activate Provider Organizational ID (Portfolio only)
formFields.hint: Only for Portfolio — the ID given by your accelerator/VC. Leave blank for Founders package.

formFields.label: What are you building? Describe your product and the problem it solves.
formFields.hint: Reviewers look for a clear, specific product with a real use case for AWS. Name the concrete AWS services you plan to use (EC2, S3, RDS, Bedrock, etc.) and tie them to real workloads — vague or generic answers get rejected.

formFields.label: How do you plan to use AWS?
formFields.hint: Show genuine intent to run production workloads on AWS. Mention expected monthly spend and specific services so the credit request looks proportionate and legitimate.

approvalTips: Make sure your website domain matches your work email domain — a mismatch is one of the most common rejection reasons.
Have a real, live landing page that clearly describes your product before applying — placeholder or parked pages get denied.
State your funding stage accurately: apply for Founders if self-funded, Portfolio only if you genuinely have an Activate Provider ID.
Name concrete AWS services you will use (e.g. EC2, S3, RDS, Bedrock) rather than saying 'cloud hosting' generically.
Use the AWS account ID you actually intend to build on and that has not previously received Activate credits.
For Portfolio, apply within 12 months of your most recent funding round and include the correct Organizational ID from your accelerator or VC.
